# Functions
```{r functions}

movingAverage <- function(x, n=1, centered=FALSE) 
{	if (centered) {
        before <- floor  ((n-1)/2)
        after  <- ceiling((n-1)/2)
    } else {
        before <- n-1
        after  <- 0
    }
    s     <- rep(0, length(x))
    count <- rep(0, length(x))
	new <- x
    count <- count + !is.na(new)
    new[is.na(new)] <- 0
    s <- s + new
	i <- 1
    while (i <= before) {
        new   <- c(rep(NA, i), x[1:(length(x)-i)])
		count <- count + !is.na(new)
        new[is.na(new)] <- 0
        s <- s + new
        i <- i+1
    }
    i <- 1
    while (i <= after) {
        new   <- c(x[(i+1):length(x)], rep(NA, i))
        count <- count + !is.na(new)
        new[is.na(new)] <- 0
        s <- s + new
        i <- i+1
    }
    s/count
}
```


# Loading ED50, Color, Sample Metadata, and MAPP Metadata
```{r load metadata}
#read in ed50 data (to know which samples were used in cbass) + to join
ed50<-read.csv(here("Data", "EDsdf-all.csv"))
color<- read.csv(here("Outputs", "color_slope.csv"))
# colony_metadata<-read.csv(here ("Data/TUT_experimental_data.csv"))
cbass_metadata<-read.csv(here("Data", "full_cbass_dataset.csv"))
cbass_meta_clean <- cbass_metadata %>%
  dplyr::rename(SampleID_clean = SpeciesID_clean)
metric_lookup <- read.csv(here("Data", "MAPP_Metric_Lookup_Table_Compact.csv"))

#clean and merge metadata
extra_metadata <- cbass_meta_clean %>%
  dplyr::select(SampleID_clean, Tank_color, Size_cm, Partial_mortality, Colony_depth_ft, DW)
color_metrics <- color %>%
  dplyr::select(SampleID, color_int = int, color_slope = slope, color_r2 = r2, color_p = p)
ed <- ed50 %>%
  left_join(color_metrics, by = c("SampleID_clean" = "SampleID")) %>%
  left_join(extra_metadata, by = "SampleID_clean") %>%
  relocate(SampleID_clean, Site, Species, ED5, ED50, ED95)
#write.csv(ed, here("Outputs/ed50_colorslope_metadata.csv"))

# Read the mapping file
sample_meta_raw <- read.csv(here("Data", "ESA_coral_data_entry_2026-Collections.csv"), check.names = FALSE)
sample_meta_raw <- sample_meta_raw[, !is.na(names(sample_meta_raw)) & names(sample_meta_raw) != ""]
mapplist        <- read.csv(here("Data", "MAPP_Metadata-Sheet1.csv"), check.names = FALSE)

sample_meta_prepped <- sample_meta_raw %>%
  filter(`CBASS / Sophie` == "CBASS") %>%
  mutate(
    Bag_number = as.integer(`Bag #`),
    Site       = as.integer(str_extract(Site, "\\d+")),
    Date       = trimws(as.character(Date)),
    Species    = trimws(toupper(Species))
  )

mapplist_prepped <- mapplist %>%
  mutate(
    Bag_number = as.integer(Bag_number),
    Date       = trimws(as.character(Date)),
    Species    = trimws(toupper(Species))
  )

sample_metadata <- sample_meta_prepped %>%
  left_join(
    mapplist_prepped %>% 
      dplyr::select(Bag_number, Species, Date, Genotype, Latitude, Longitude, Cookie_no, Sophie) %>%
      distinct(Bag_number, Species, Date, .keep_all = TRUE), # Safety deduplication on exact composite key
    by = c("Bag_number", "Species", "Date")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    SampleID_clean = paste(Site, Species, Genotype, sep = "_") %>%
      trimws() %>%
      toupper()
  )

#write.csv(sample_metadata, file = here("Outputs", "AS26_MAPPmetadata.csv"), row.names = TRUE)


```
# Phenotyping
### Load and Compile Processed Phenotype Data
```{r compiling processed pheno}
###### compiling all photophys to one csv ################# 
data_dir <- here("Data", "phenotyping_data", "normalized")

# 1. Get list of valid CBASS files
file_list <- list.files(
  path = data_dir, 
  full.names = TRUE, 
  pattern = "^[^aoiAOI]"
)

# 2. Extract metric description columns (uni, metric, stage, col, metrix) from first file
photophys_meta <- read.csv(file_list[1])[, 2:6]

# 3. Read metric values across all files, naming columns by their raw MessyID
metric_list <- map(file_list, ~ read.csv(.x)[, 7])
names(metric_list) <- path_file(file_list) # Retains raw file names for lookup_df

# 4. Combine into wide photophysiology frame
photophys_raw <- bind_cols(photophys_meta, as.data.frame(metric_list))

# Save raw compiled photophys dataset
#write.csv(photophys, file = here("Outputs", "photophys_compiled.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

```

# clean and transpose data
```{r}
# Filter out Fo/Fm (they were used for the calculation of some of the metrics, makign it redundant/artificially collinear to keep them in.)
photophys <- photophys_raw %>% 
  filter(!metric %in% c("Fo", "Fm", "fo", "fm"))

longphoto <- photophys %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(uni, metric, stage, col, metrix),
    names_to = "MessyID",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !(startsWith(MessyID, "t7") & grepl("icra|ahya", MessyID) & endsWith(MessyID, "005r.processed.csv")),
    !(startsWith(MessyID, "t7") & grepl("aglo|aabr", MessyID) & endsWith(MessyID, "002r.processed.csv")),
    !grepl("\\copy", MessyID, ignore.case = TRUE)
  )
#############################CHANGE
# Systematically filter extreme outliers across ALL metrics
longphoto_clean <- longphoto %>%
  group_by(metric, col, stage) %>%
  mutate(
    Q1 = quantile(Value, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q3 = quantile(Value, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    IQR = Q3 - Q1,
    lower_bound = Q1 - 3 * IQR, # Use 3.0 * IQR for conservative filtering
    upper_bound = Q3 + 3 * IQR
  ) %>%
  filter(Value >= lower_bound & Value <= upper_bound) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(-Q1, -Q3, -IQR, -lower_bound, -upper_bound)

# Re-pivot to wide format after outlier filtering
widephoto2 <- longphoto_clean %>%
  dplyr::select(MessyID, uni, Value) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = uni,
    values_from = Value
  )

#lookup df and grab annotation_col from widephoto
lookup_df <- data.frame(MessyID = widephoto2$MessyID) %>%
  mutate(
    SampleID_clean = MessyID %>%
      # Remove leading T from timepoint prefix if present (e.g., T1_ -> 1_)
      sub("^T(?=\\d+_)", "", ., perl = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE) %>%
      # Strip run numbers, extensions, and anything following the dash
      sub("[-._]\\d{2,3}R.*$", "", ., ignore.case = TRUE) %>%
      sub("[-._]PROCESSED.*$", "", ., ignore.case = TRUE) %>%
      # Ensure uppercase species codes
      toupper() %>%
      # Insert underscore between species and colony number (AGLO10 -> AGLO_10)
      sub("([A-Z]{4})(\\d+)$", "\\1_\\2", .)
  )

widephoto2 <- widephoto2 %>%
  left_join(lookup_df, by = "MessyID") %>%
  relocate(SampleID_clean, .after = MessyID)%>%
  filter(SampleID_clean %in% ed50$SampleID_clean)
```

```{r}
# Ensure unique row identifier for matrix row names
widephoto2 <- widephoto2 %>%
  distinct(SampleID_clean, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Store clean sample IDs for row names
sample_names <- widephoto2$SampleID_clean

# Select ONLY numeric metric columns 
fullyears <- widephoto2 %>%
  dplyr::select(-any_of(c("MessyID", "SampleID", "SampleID_clean", "Species", "Site", "Date", "Run"))) %>%
  # Keep columns that are strictly numeric
  dplyr::select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
  as.data.frame()

# Assign sample IDs directly as matrix row names
rownames(fullyears) <- sample_names

# Remove columns with all NAs, any NA values, or zero standard deviation
bad_cols <- colSums(is.na(fullyears)) > 0 | 
  sapply(fullyears, function(x) is.na(sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)) || sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) == 0)

fullyears_clean <- fullyears[, !bad_cols, drop = FALSE]

Alls.cntn <- fullyears_clean

# Pre-process using range method [0, 1]
Alls.transit <- preProcess(Alls.cntn, method = "range")
Alls.trans   <- predict(Alls.transit, Alls.cntn)

cat(sprintf("Pre-processed Matrix: %d samples x %d metrics\n", 
            nrow(Alls.trans), ncol(Alls.trans)))

# unfiltered clean matrix ready for PERMANOVA / Clustering
Alls.cor_clean <- as.matrix(Alls.trans)

# Calculate Pearson correlation matrix across metrics
descrCor <- cor(Alls.cor_clean)

#save(Alls.cor_clean, file = here("Data", "Alls.cor_clean.RData"))

#alls<-load(here("Data/Alls.cor_clean.RData"))
```


```{r}
# PERMANOVA Matrix (Samples as Rows, Metrics as Columns)
permanova_matrix2 <- Alls.cor_clean
storage.mode(permanova_matrix2) <- "numeric"

#write.csv(permanova_matrix, file = here("Outputs", "permanova_matrix_clean.csv"), row.names = TRUE)

#make a metrics family column
metric_names <- colnames(permanova_matrix2)


# Filter and order ed to match permanova_matrix row order
ed_aligned <- ed %>%
  filter(SampleID_clean %in% rownames(permanova_matrix2)) %>%
  arrange(match(SampleID_clean, rownames(permanova_matrix2)))

# Set row names of metadata to SampleID_clean for direct mapping in pheatmap/vegan
rownames(ed_aligned) <- ed_aligned$SampleID_clean


# calc Pearson correlation matrix across metrics
cor_matrix <- cor(permanova_matrix2, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "pearson")
cor_matrix[is.na(cor_matrix) | is.nan(cor_matrix)] <- 0

# run findCorrelation at 0.90
cor_cutoff <- 0.90
high_cor_idx <- findCorrelation(cor_matrix, cutoff = cor_cutoff)

# id traits to retain (handles edge case where high_cor_idx is empty)
if (length(high_cor_idx) > 0) {
  retained_trait_names <- colnames(permanova_matrix2)[-high_cor_idx]
} else {
  retained_trait_names <- colnames(permanova_matrix2)
}

cat("Total initial traits:", ncol(permanova_matrix2), "\n")
cat("Traits retained after correlation (r =", cor_cutoff, ") filtering:", length(retained_trait_names), "\n")

#get metric info from lookup table
# Join directly to retained traits to pull Family & Short Name from the CSV
#    (Adjust column names below to match your exact CSV headers, e.g., "Metric_Family" or "Family")
# Get metric info from lookup table using correct column names
metric_families <- data.frame(Metric_Code = retained_trait_names) %>%
  left_join(metric_lookup, by = c("Metric_Code" = "Metric.Name")) %>%
  mutate(
    # Use Root.Metric if available, otherwise fall back to Metric_Code
    Clean_Label = ifelse(!is.na(Root.Metric) & Root.Metric != "", Root.Metric, Metric_Code)
  )

# Create named vector for plot annotations/labels
metric_label_map <- setNames(metric_families$Clean_Label, metric_families$Metric_Code)


# Subset filtered traits (Samples x Retained Metrics)
permanova_matrix_filtered2 <- permanova_matrix2[, retained_trait_names, drop = FALSE]

# Ensure metadata strictly matches the exact sample order of the filtered matrix
meta_filtered2 <- ed_aligned %>%
  filter(SampleID_clean %in% rownames(permanova_matrix_filtered2)) %>%
  arrange(match(SampleID_clean, rownames(permanova_matrix_filtered2)))

# Verify row order is identical (CRITICAL for vegan functions)
stopifnot(identical(rownames(permanova_matrix_filtered2), meta_filtered2$SampleID_clean))

```

```{r}
# =================================
# hclust
# =================================
set.seed(123)
fit_cbb2 <- pvclust(
  t(permanova_matrix_filtered2),
  method.hclust = "ward.D2",
  method.dist   = "canberra",
  nboot         = 10000,
  parallel      = TRUE
)

#load(here("Outputs", "photophys_preprocessed_data.RData"))

# get hclust tree from pvclust fit
my_hclust2 <- fit_cbb2$hclust
original_labels <- my_hclust2$labels # SampleIDs (e.g., "11_AABR_1")

# extract cluster across K = 2 through K = 15
k_matrix2 <- cutree(my_hclust2, k = 2:15)

# convert into a clean lookup dataframe with "K_2", "K_3" columns
k_lookup2 <- as.data.frame(k_matrix2) %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0("K_", 2:15)) %>%
  rownames_to_column("SampleID_clean") %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("K_"), ~ factor(paste0("Cluster_", .x))))

# join all K_2 through K_15 cluster columns into meta_filtered
meta_filteredK2 <- meta_filtered2 %>%
  left_join(k_lookup2, by = "SampleID_clean")

# verify row alignment
stopifnot(identical(rownames(permanova_matrix_filtered2), meta_filteredK2$SampleID_clean))

cat("\n--- K_3 CLUSTER DISTRIBUTION ACROSS SPECIES ---\n")
print(table(meta_filteredK2$K_3, meta_filteredK2$Species))

print(table(meta_filteredK2$K_3, meta_filteredK2$Species, meta_filteredK2$Site))
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggtree)
library(ggnewscale)
library(here)

# =========================================================================
# 1. PREPARE METADATA DATAFRAME
# =========================================================================
# Ensure meta_filteredK has clean factors and labels
meta_tree <- meta_filteredK2 %>%
  mutate(
    # Format K_3 labels to match roman_map ("Cluster I", "Cluster II", "Cluster III")
    K_3_label = roman_map[as.character(K_3)],
    K_3_label = factor(K_3_label, levels = c("Cluster I", "Cluster II", "Cluster III")),
    Symbiont  = "Durusdinium trenchii",
    Site      = as.factor(Site),
    Species   = as.factor(Species)
  )

# Set Cluster Colors
cluster_cols <- c(
  "Cluster I"   = "violet",
  "Cluster II"  = "orange",
  "Cluster III" = "cyan"
)
symbiont_cols <- c("Durusdinium trenchii" = "#2E8B57")
# =========================================================================
# 2. BUILD BASE GGTREE WITH SPP LEAF SHAPES
# =========================================================================
# Convert hclust tree directly to a ggtree object
p_tree <- ggtree(my_hclust2) %<+% meta_tree +
  geom_tippoint(aes(shape = Species, fill = Site), size = 2.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = site_colors) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = species_shapes) +
  theme_tree2() +
  labs(title = "Photophysiological Dendrogram (ggtree Alignment)")
# =========================================================================
# 2. BUILD BASE GGTREE WITH SITE LEAF SHAPES
# =========================================================================
# Convert hclust tree directly to a ggtree object
p_tree <- ggtree(my_hclust2) %<+% meta_tree +
  geom_tippoint(aes(shape = Site), size = 2.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = site_colors) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = site_shapes) +
  theme_tree2() +
  labs(title = "Photophysiological Dendrogram (ggtree Alignment)")

# =========================================================================
# 3. ATTACH COLOR HEATMAP TILES TO LEAVES (MATCHED BY SampleID_clean)
# ========================================================================
# Track 1: Cluster (K=3)
df_k3 <- meta_tree %>% 
  dplyr::select(SampleID_clean, `Cluster (K=3)` = K_3_label) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("SampleID_clean")

p_tree1 <- gheatmap(p_tree, df_k3, offset = 50, width = 0.05, colnames_angle = 90, colnames_offset_y = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cluster_cols, name = "Cluster (K=3)")

# Track 2: Symbiont Species
p_tree2 <- p_tree1 + new_scale_fill()

df_sym <- meta_tree %>% 
  dplyr::select(SampleID_clean, `Symbiont Species` = Symbiont) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("SampleID_clean")

p_tree3 <- gheatmap(p_tree2, df_sym, offset = 150, width = 0.05, colnames_angle = 90, colnames_offset_y = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = symbiont_cols, name = "Symbiont Species")

# Track 3: Host Species
p_tree4 <- p_tree3 + new_scale_fill()

df_host <- meta_tree %>% 
  dplyr::select(SampleID_clean, `Host Species` = Species) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("SampleID_clean")

p_final <- gheatmap(p_tree4, df_host, offset = 250, width = 0.05, colnames_angle = 90, colnames_offset_y = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = species_colors, name = "Host Species")

# =========================================================================
# 4. SAVE HIGH-RES PLOT
# =========================================================================
```
